title: Guided Paddleboard Snorkel Tour in Rainbow River
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Rainbow River in Dunnellon, Florida aboard a clear-bottom kayak. Paddle through crystal-clear spring water surrounded by wildlife and beautiful scenery. Great for families and beginners, with optional swimming and snorkeling stops along the way.

Guests may switch craft by calling ahead. Options include tandem sit-on-top kayaks, single V-hull sit-on-top kayaks with cup holders and extra leg room, carbon fiber paddleboards, single clear kayaks, and crystal-clear tandem kayaks.

• Launch from KP Hole County Park
• 2 to 2.5 hour eco tour
• Beginner and family friendly
• Optional swimming and snorkeling stops
• Multiple craft options available upon request
